description: Commercial biomechanics report with strict metric semantics. Every metric carries kind, validity, confidence, residual, units, and value. Personal/practice/strategy sections are schema placeholders until the personal engine ships.

truth.description: Citeable wrist / timing / trajectory P0 metrics (measured or derived).

inference.description: Proxy and inferred high-order metrics. Never claim measured / launch-monitor truth.

personal_baseline.description: Signed errors vs personal biomech prior. Placeholder only in this release.

practice_loop.description: Next-shot correction features for practice loop. Schema frozen; engine not wired.

strategy.description: Round strategy / SG precursor features. Schema frozen; engine not wired.

swing_report_compatibility: CommercialSwingReport is an export projection; SwingReport fields and pipeline return type are unchanged.
